title: Ziwei Battle Against Ancient Kings
summary: The purple bronze warship Ye Fan saw in space arrives over Ziwei. From a cliff, a Golden Crow elder and the clan's First Crown Prince (Immortal Platform 2nd Heaven) choose to stay out of it. A coffin that drains life for hundreds of thousands of li releases an ancestral king. The Golden-haired and Silver-haired Great Saints boast that Ziwei is only the first step toward devouring Beidou and every other star field. The Old Madman stands alone against the two Great Saints and more than a dozen ancient kings, behind an Immortal Divine Tree formation. Ye Fan joins in with the Black Gourd's Dao Sword. The Old Madman's Six Paths Reincarnation Fist sends enemies to their deaths. Then the Thousand-Armed Divine Demon, a Great Saint at the 6th Heaven of Immortal Platform, fully wakes and smashes the formation. Ye Fan tries to hold it together with the Mother Qi Cauldron, and the episode ends on a cliffhanger.
